STAGE: shape/permutation check before scoring.
GOAL: fix the schema rejection ("ranks are not a permutation of 1..6") and confirm the proposal set.
READ: the prompt block; it contains 7 proposals (GYRO-BEHAFF-SID, BCMID-L3-RQ, CGREP-4L-RQ, HOLO-TILT-L3, BISECT-L4-ASYM, HYSPLIT-BEHV-RQ, BEHDIR-L4) and 7 evidence bundles (68dcd879..., 28b5638c..., 7e2173f0..., 3e67caf8..., 8381a1fa..., caf10ee0..., 6320f35e...).
OBSERVED: the rejected answer emitted 6 RANK lines with positions [1,3,4,5,6,7], i.e. one proposal duplicated/missing and 2 absent, so the set was not {1..N}. There is no append_progress write path other than this tool; no file system read is needed and no experiment is run.
REASONING: the only fix is 7 RANK lines with positions exactly 1..7 and one 5-line block per idea_id, every id once. I will rank by expected single-run chance of Stage3 test_recall@10 > 0.065 given the frozen baseline and the measured beam/NLL evidence.
EVIDENCE LOCATION: prompt text only; no local files.
OPEN: final scores and ranks (next record).

STAGE: evidence reading and scoring decisions.
GOAL: ground each placement in the frozen bundle rather than in the proposal motivations.
READ: bundle entries common to all ideas E4-E11, plus the per-idea E1-E3 (behaviour) and E12-E14 (geometry). Key numbers: E6 beam survival l1_br recall@10 0.04671, target-in-beams 0.0678, depth 1/2/3/4 alive 1.000/1.000/1.000/0.068; l1_br_euclid 0.06207 (0.0847) depths 1.000/0.829/0.161/0.085; resample 0.06363 (0.0884) depths 0.497/0.122/0.091/0.088; successor_entropy 0.05122; successor_geodesic_coarse 0.05500. E7 NLL: l1_br T1-T4 0.00/0.00/0.00/9.03; l1_br_euclid 0.00/3.22/4.36/1.23; resample 4.55/3.82/0.73/0.05. E8 shared-cluster share K=16 0.3106 (neg 0.1352), K=64 0.1547 (0.0376), K=256 0.0822 (0.0129). E9 0.9291 vs 0.8871 cohort share, 0.5898 pairwise-beats-all-ten-negatives, 1.65 nats over 7.5 cohorts. E10 115582 distinct edges, 118315 edges, mean_outgoing_degree 5.4526 over 24556 items. E11 same_first_prefix 0.0907 vs permuted null 0.067.
OBSERVED: (a) the deepest position is the failure point (E7 T3/T4 NLL, E6 depth-4 survival 0.068); (b) Euclidean beam beats the hyperbolic beam by 0.015 recall (E6), so curvature has not yet paid in the search; (c) behaviour co-location is strongest at coarse K (E8), so fine 512-code behaviour conditioning is the risky regime; (d) transitions are sparse (~4.7 out-edges/item, E10) so only direction-style use survives; (e) the bundle never measures successor-minus-predecessor asymmetry nor any repulsive use of contrast, so ideas keyed on those are only partly grounded; (f) GYRO's coupling line E14 is truncated and E13/E5 are cut in the other bundles.
REASONING: rank on expected single-run recall, weighting non-destruction of the existing partition over novelty, because the target 0.065 sits just under the 0.0678 frozen figure in E6.
EVIDENCE LOCATION: frozen bundles quoted above.
OPEN: final numbers and ranks.

STAGE: final answer, corrected permutation.
GOAL: deliver 7 RANK lines with positions 1..7 (previous attempt emitted positions 1,3,4,5,6,7 and was rejected) plus one 5-line block per proposal.
READ: frozen bundles E4-E11 shared by all ideas; per-idea E1-E3 and E12-E14. Key: E6 l1_br 0.04671 (depth4 alive 0.068) vs l1_br_euclid 0.06207 vs resample 0.06363 (target-in-beams 0.0678); E7 T3/T4 NLL l1_br 0.00/9.03, euclid 4.36/1.23, resample 0.73/0.05; E8 co-location 0.3106 at K=16 -> 0.0822 at K=256; E9 0.5898 pairwise, 0.9291 vs 0.8871; E10 4.7 out-edges/item; E11 0.0907 vs 0.067 null. Note E14 of GYRO and E13 of four bundles are truncated.
OBSERVED/REASONING: deepest position is the loss point; Euclidean beats hyperbolic in the beam; behaviour is reliable at coarse K only; transitions sparse; the bundle never measures p_out-p_in asymmetry nor repulsion, so BISECT/HYSPLIT/CGREP are only partly grounded. Rank on single-run chance of recall@10>0.065 with non-destruction weighted highest because the bar sits just under the 0.0678 frozen figure.
RESULT: 1 BEHDIR-L4 (26), 2 BISECT-L4-ASYM (25), 3 HYSPLIT-BEHV-RQ (25), 4 BCMID-L3-RQ (22), 5 GYRO-BEHAFF-SID (21), 6 CGREP-4L-RQ (15), 7 HOLO-TILT-L3 (14). All 7 in scope; HOLO flagged marginal on geometric necessity.
OPEN: none; no arm is trained, this is a ranking only.
